ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given that O is a point on line AB, and OC $\perp$ OE. As shown in the diagram, when ray OC is below line AB, OF bisects $\angle AOE$, $\angle BOE = 130^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle COF$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\angle BOE = 130^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOE = 180^\circ - \angle BOE = 50^\circ$\\
Since OF bisects $\angle AOE$,\\
we have $\angle EOF = \frac{1}{2} \angle AOE = 25^\circ = \angle AOF$\\
Since $OC \perp OE$,\\
it follows that $\angle COF = 90^\circ - \angle EOF = \boxed{65^\circ}$;
